function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today. For the most up‑to‑date figure, check a trusted financial news outlet (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC) or a commodity‑price website such as Kitco or the U.S. Treasury’s own data releases. Those sources publish the current U.S. dollar price per ounce of gold in real time.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the gold price today in USA?" We need to provide the current gold price. We don't have real-time data. According to policy, we should not fabricate or guess. We can say we don't have real-time data. We could suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or the US Mint. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking reputable financial news sites.
